 ORDER
This writ petition has been filed challenging the order passed by the second respondent, dated 15.10.2024 thereby cancelled the licence of the petitioner and also and lock and sealed the shop.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials placed before this Court.
3.
The petitioner was running a grocery shop with tea shop at K.Puthupatti Village, Tharmapatti Post, Singampunari Taluk, Sivagangai District under the licence from the Food and Safety Department.
While being so, on 10.10.2024 the second respondent conducted an inspection on the petitioner's shop and found the Tobacco products.

The petitioner was also directed to pay a fine of Rs.25,000/- https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis under Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, however, the petitioner has not paid the said amount.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner's licence was cancelled and his shop was also lock and sealed by the second respondent under Section 32(3) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and 2.1.8(4) of Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011.
5.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the above, on payment of fine amount imposed against the petitioner to the second respondent, the second respondent is directed to remove the lock and seal of the petitioner's premises.
6. With the above direction, the writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
